subject: 赊店山陕会馆 · 悬鉴楼戏台正面
author: Windmemories
source_note: 2025年悬鉴楼院内近正面照片，保留中央三重檐和附连双侧楼，删除独立观戏长廊、游客及供具；所有檐层已与实照逐项核对。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.


SUBJECT-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS:
Draw ONLY the Xuanzjian Lou 悬鉴楼, the historic opera stage building of the Sheqi Shan-Shan Guild Hall in Shedian, Henan, seen prominently in the centre of photo 2. Use the actual complete front theatre group: tall central stage with THREE overlapping roof/eave levels, crowned by one very large high hip-and-gable roof; the lower front roof projects above the open central performance stage, with one lower narrow roof over that forward central bay. The central stage is raised on a stone platform with an open passage beneath. Keep the two symmetrical flanking two-storey tower wings attached to the theatre group, each with two roof levels and open lower passages. Preserve the source building arrangement exactly; do not multiply pavilions or flatten the high central roof. Remove the separate long audience galleries at the far left/right edges, foreground kiosk, plants, people, barriers and all background. Bring only this symmetrical central stage complex into one near-frontal isolated building plate. Keep sparse column-and-beam outlines, a few large ridge ornaments and selective bracket outlines. Make every roof plane blank white; NO rows of roof tiles or tiny densely repeated ornaments; door/room interiors white too. Do not include signs or Chinese characters. Entire stage complex including wing roofs and stone platform centered in landscape1536x1024, breathing room of at least100 pixels around all extremities. A calm airy elegant thin-line drawing consistent with the master, no dark fills and no hatching.

historical_sources.title: 河南日报：社旗山陕会馆，会馆行里称翘楚（管理者及测绘者访谈）
historical_sources.supports: 会馆分期建设、悬鉴楼前期营建、大拜殿等1869后建设。

historical_sources.title: 中原文化：社旗山陕会馆
historical_sources.supports: 悬鉴楼戏楼性质和嘉庆至道光建设阶段；文中公元换算笔误不照录。

site_recommendation.name: 赊店山陕会馆
site_recommendation.era: 清 · 嘉庆至道光时期
site_recommendation.yearNote: 1800为悬鉴楼所属清代营建阶段的约略排序点。官方转载有“嘉庆元年=1786”换算错误，故不沿用该数值作为精确竣工年；会馆1756—1892为全组建造阶段。
site_recommendation.place: 河南 · 南阳 · 社旗县赊店镇
site_recommendation.lede: 赊店山陕会馆的悬鉴楼把戏台抬在院落上方，中央三重檐与两侧楼阁相接。商旅会馆中的酬神演剧，由层叠屋面和通透台口共同组织。

facts.label: 会馆
facts.text: 山西、陕西商人集资兴建，会馆兼具同乡聚会与祭祀关公的用途。

facts.label: 分期
facts.text: 全组会馆自1756年起分期营建至1892年，悬鉴楼属前期工程，未将全组始建年直接作为戏楼建年。

facts.label: 戏楼
facts.text: 悬鉴楼为会馆戏台，以三重檐主体和两侧楼阁形成对称布局；本图剔除另立的两侧观戏长廊。
